title: Quality is built in the passes after the first draft
takeaway: A presentation quality system must reserve time and attention for composition, critique and refinement—not just first-pass generation.
compositionBrief: A restrained data-storytelling slide with one source-labelled illustrative distribution, custom horizontal bars and an interpretation. The illustrative status must be visible on the exported slide. Do not use generic cards or decorative icons.

elements.text: Quality is built in the passes after the first draft

elements.title: Illustrative distribution of design effort
elements.interpretation: Review and refinement receive the largest share in this example. Real decks must replace these illustrative values with measured or sourced evidence.

sources.title: PPD synthetic demonstration values — illustrative only, not measured industry data
